sources.name: Google Influence Operations Bulletin, quarterly pages on blog.google, found from the security RSS and the URL pattern

sources.name: OpenAI news RSS feed (openai.com/news/rss.xml) only; report pages are never fetched
sources.licence: OpenAI Terms of Use (effective 1 Jan 2026) bar programmatic extraction from its websites; the RSS feed is offered for machine reading. Title and one-line summary quoted with credit

sources.name: TikTok's reports to the EU Code of Conduct on Disinformation, Transparency Centre JSON (disinfocode.eu/reports/tiktok/<n>/json); never tiktok.com
sources.licence: No terms of use stated by the Transparency Centre (none found 14 Nov 2026); robots.txt allows all

sources.name: EEAS 4th report on FIMI threats (March 2026): named Information Manipulation Sets entered once into config/register/eeas-fimi-4.json with page numbers; the FIMI page is read each run for a newer report
sources.licence: EEAS legal notice: reuse authorised provided the source is acknowledged

sources.name: Atlantic Council's Digital Forensic Research Lab (DFRLab) RSS feed (dfrlab.org/feed/, paged); reporter lane: only articles naming an operation in config/operations.json are kept, folded into reported-activity items; article pages are never fetched
sources.licence: Atlantic Council Terms and Conditions of Use (read 16 Nov 2026): noncommercial copies with the Council's notices; automated access no faster than a person; no personal information harvested. Names, dates and links only, no DFRLab text

sources.name: CheckFirst RSS feed (checkfirst.network/feed/, paged); reporter lane: only articles naming an operation in config/operations.json are kept, folded into reported-activity items; article pages are never fetched
sources.licence: No terms of use published (privacy policy only; read 16 Nov 2026). Its llms.txt: welcome to read, index and cite, attributing findings to CheckFirst with a link to the original publication. robots.txt allows all but admin and search. Names, dates and links only, no CheckFirst text

sources.name: CORRECTIV English RSS feed (correctiv.org/en/feed/, paged); reporter lane: only stories naming an operation in config/operations.json are kept, folded into reported-activity items; article pages are never fetched
sources.licence: No terms of use or licence found (legal disclosure and imprint only; read 16 Nov 2026), so all rights reserved. robots.txt does not disallow the feed. Facts only: names, dates and links, no CORRECTIV text

sources.name: Undertow watch register (config/register/watch.json): reported activity naming no tracked operation, entered by hand from the private triage list after the analyst's review
sources.licence: Each row records its reporter's terms; names, dates and links only

sources.name: DISARM Framework v1.6.1, STIX 2.1 bundle (DISARMFoundation/DISARMframeworks, generated_files/DISARM_STIX/DISARM.json at tag v1.6.1); a cut is vendored in config/disarm/
